pages.title: Clydesdale
pages.text: Scotland's draft giant, and the showiest of the four. Built on the Percheron's frame under a great deal of white feather, it is a carriage and parade horse before it is a ploughing one - quicker than the Percheron and better over a fence than either the Shire or the Belgian.

pages.title: Coat
pages.text:
Bay, brown, black and roan, and on top of all of them the white: a broad blaze, tall stockings and a splash along the belly. That white is the same thing as the feather.

- Bay Sabino
- Seal Brown
- Black Sabino
- Red Bay
- Chestnut Roan *(uncommon)*
- Dapple Bay *(uncommon)*
- Sooty Bay *(uncommon)*
- Rose Roan *(rare)*
